title: Snapdrop — a minimal photo uploader
description: A focused React and Vite demo of Snapback's local asset pipeline: upload progress, trusted image finalization, typed attachment, live gallery updates, and public immutable delivery.

backend.stalenessPolicy: regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headless: the stock @expo/snapback-vite relay forwards the author-facing /assets/* family and still refuses /_snapback/* system routes
sessions sign-in completes through the trusted-local mailbox seam with both admin carriers held server-side
the typed generated upload reference (api.photoUpload, no cast) uploads a PNG to ready through the relay
the typed attachment mutation commits and the live gallery query observes the row over the relayed WebSocket
the public display rendition serves 200 image/* through the relay to a plain fetch
react: strict typecheck against the generated api.d.ts (no upload-reference cast)
managed dev loop starts Snapback and Vite
browser uploads a PNG and sees it in the live gallery

capabilityGaps: hosted asset storage is not claimed by the current target
dev-mode asset HTTP resolves anonymous, so the authenticated intent requires sessions custody; the browser sign-in code arrives through the trusted-local dev mailbox seam

capabilityGapsBoundary.reason: These entries describe boundaries of this local asset demo, not current platform GAP rows.
